claims.text: Royal Order A/159 dated 10/7/1436 AH, issued that day according to the dateline Riyadh 10 Rajab 1436 / 29 April 2015: citing Prince Muqrin bin Abdulaziz's letter of the same date asking to be relieved of the crown princeship, King Salman relieves him, at his request, of the crown princeship and of the post of Deputy Prime Minister.
claims.locator: Dateline; order number and date; recital and item First; trailer (filed 06:16 Makkah time)
claims.uncertainty: A relief at his own request, not a death. No Allegiance Commission vote is stated for the relief.

claims.text: Item Second of the same order selects Prince Mohammed bin Nayef bin Abdulaziz as Crown Prince and appoints him Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Interior and Chairman of the Council of Political and Security Affairs; the preamble cites Royal Order A/52 of 3/4/1436 AH.
claims.uncertainty: No Allegiance Commission vote is stated for this selection. A/52 was cited but not read.

scope_note: The release ends with 'to follow'; its continuation, Royal Order A/160, is recorded separately (sa_spa_order_a160_20150429). Used for SA-EXEC-06.
